name: 曾恕銘
objective: 課程主要為介紹機器學習概念和基本原理，學習 DNN/CNN/LSTM/transformer 的神經網路架構和其他機器學習方法。
schedule:
1.	Introduction
2.	DNN with labs
case study: OFDMA/NOMA resource allocaion
3.	Learning method with labs (AI 玩遊戲)
4.	CNN with labs (AI 影像分類/物件偵測)
5.	RNN LSTM with lab
case study: Polar code decoding in impulse noise channel
6.	Analogizers: K-means, kNN, SVM
7.	transformer (GAI/LLM)
case study: scene boundary detection (AI 影片分章) (optional)
8.	(optional) Naïve Bayes classifier (AI 判斷貸款會違約嗎)
9.	(optional) Symbolists: Decision Tree (AI 判斷貸款會違約嗎)
10.	Autodecoder (AI 影像去雜訊/著色)  with labs
11. Deep Reinforcement Learning (AlphaGo 下圍棋勝世界冠軍，OpenAI Five 玩 Dota 2 勝世界冠軍)
case study RIS DRL (optional)
scorePolicy:
口頭報告 30%
Lab report 35% (一組口頭報告 1  lab)
期末考 35%
課程參與 (extra) 10%
